paite: Singgi sing in maitam na bawl ding a, tong nga a sau, tong nga a za; maitam detdou ahi ding. Asanlam tong thum ahi ding ahi.
heading: Maitam / (Eks 38.1-7)

paite: Aning lite tung ah akiite na bawl dia; akiite akibang ding ua; dal in na luan ding ahi.
Ameivu dohna ding belte na bawl ding a, aluahna suahdul, kuangdal, keupi leh asikkhut leh amei beldai. Abelsuan tengteng dal a na bawl ding ahi.
Huai a ding in dal in sing khul ding koihna len bang in na bawl dia; atung a ning li ah dal sikkual li na bawl ding ahi.
Anuailam maitam huapna nuai ah na koih dia; huchi a maitam laizang a, lente akikim theihna ding in.
Maitam a ding in chiangte na bawl dia, singgi sing chiangte dal in na luan ding ahi.
Chiangte sikkual sung a thunlut ding ahi a; chiangte maitam sik nihte tung ah a-om ding hi, apuakna ding in.
Tang a ka hon etsak bang in, singpekte ah ahawm na bawl dia, huchibang in na bawl ding ahi.
Biakbuk huang na bawl ding ahi. Simlam pang a ding in simlam manoh in puankhai, huang umna ding in puanmalngat hoih sik khat a ding in tong za a sau a-om ding ahi.
heading: Biakbuk Huangsung / (Eks 38.9-20)

paite: Akhuam sawmnihte leh akingakna khuakkuak sawmnihte dal ahi ding ua; khuamte khainate leh puanduangte dangka ahi ding uhi.
Huchi mah bang in mallam pang ah asau lam tong za a sau puankhai a-om ding, dal khuam sawmnihte leh akingakna khuakkuak sawmnihte dangka chi khuam, akhaina leh puanduangte ahi ding hi.
Tumlam pang a huang vailam a ding in puankhai tong sawmnga a-om ding. Akhuamte uh sawm leh akingakna khuakkuak sawm ahi ding.
Suahlam a suahlam pang a huangsung umna vailam tong sawmnga ahi ding.
Kongpi sik khat lam a puankhaite tong sawm-le-nga ahi dia; akhuamte thum, akingakna khuakkuak thum ahi ding.
Langkhat lam pang ah puankhai tong sawm-le-ngate a-om dia; akhuamte thum leh akingakna khuakkuak thum ahi ding.
Huangsung kongpi a ding in puankhai tong sawmnih a-om dia, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah, phim a khui ahi dia, akhuam uh li ahi dia, akingakna khuakkuak li ahi ding hi.
Huangsung kimvel a khuam tengteng dangka puanduang a gak ahi dia, abannate dangka ahi dia, akingakna khuakkuak dal ahi ding hi.
Huangsung dunglam tong zakhat ahi dia, availam tong sawmnga koipeuh ah, asanlam tong nga puanmalngat hoih koptah a bawl, akingakna khuakkuak dal ahi ding.
Biakbuk a vanzat tengteng, anasepna chiteng, akilhbelhna sikzumte leh huangsung a kilhbelhna sikzum tengteng dal ahi ding ahi.
Israel suante meivak ding in olive thautak a bawl hon tawi ding in thu na pe ding, khawnvak kuangsak gige ding in.
heading: Khawnvak Kepdan Ding

paite: Puanzak, theihpihna ma a om, polam a kihoupihna puanin ah, Aaron leh atapate'n TOUPA ma ah nitaklam a pan zingsang lam tan in thu ape ding uhi. Israel suante ziak in akhang-akhang un tangtawn a ding in dan thuseh ahi ding hi.
